fit: One Gauss-Newton step at originalA; all original4teacher coefficients, full1024 current states, all14 layers
normal_equations: Per-network G_j and b_j average equally over14layers and1024rows; average G,b over included networks; solve (G + .1*trace(G)/64*I) deltaA=b; apply .5*deltaA
final_constants: Round proposedA tofloat32 before full-fit teacher evaluation
gate: Mean four-networkLOO relative coefficient MSE <=-1%,>=3/4 improved, coefficientRMS step<=10% of baseline coefficientRMS on all training/LOO blocks; no tuning or native launch after reject
